source.source_name: e-Business Register open data — annual report financial data (majandusaasta aruanne)
source.attribution: Attribute Registrite ja Infosüsteemide Keskus / e-Business Register (CC-BY 4.0)

mapping_rules.financials: Group {year}_aruannete_elemendid rows by report_id; pivot (elemendi_nimetus -> vaartus) within each tabel (Lõppbilanss=balance sheet, Kasumiaruanne=income statement). Attach aruannete_yldandmed metadata (year, audited, consolidated, auditor) and join registrikood to the company. Currency EUR.
mapping_rules.revenue_by_activity: Join EMTAK_myygitulu on report_id for revenue split by EMTAK activity.

fixture_requirements: balance-sheet element rows for one report_id (Assets/Equity/CurrentAssets)
income-statement element rows for one report_id (TotalAnnualPeriodProfitLoss)
EMTAK revenue rows for one report_id
report_id present in elements but missing in metadata (orphan handling)

live_test_plan.smoke: Download one year's aruannete_elemendid + aruannete_yldandmed; pivot a handful of report_ids and verify the join to a company registrikood.
live_test_plan.full: Process all years 2019-2025 + EMTAK/geographical revenue behind env gates; stream the large CSVs.
